title: Cooper 12-Minute Run Test
creator: Kenneth H. Cooper
description: Run (or walk) as far as you can in exactly 12 minutes on a flat course or track. Devised by Dr Kenneth Cooper for the US Air Force in 1968, the distance predicts VO2max closely: VO2max ≈ (metres − 504.9) / 44.73. Around 2,800 m is excellent for men in their twenties and 2,700 m for women; record the distance, not the pace.

source.title: Cooper test (Cooper K.H., A Means of Assessing Maximal Oxygen Intake, JAMA 1968)
source.author: Kenneth H. Cooper
source.license: Published protocol; description in our own words
